vulnerability.name: Docker Group Privilege Escalation
vulnerability.author: Thomas Shaw
vulnerability.description: A local user account that belongs to the docker group. Membership of the docker group is equivalent to root: a member can start a container that mounts the host filesystem (or runs a setuid payload built into an image) and so read or write any file as root. The flag is leaked to /root/ in the host filesystem, readable only after escalating to root.
vulnerability.hint: Which groups does your user belong to?
vulnerability.solution: The account is a member of the docker group, which is equivalent to root. Start a container that mounts the host filesystem, or use the Metasploit docker_daemon_privilege_escalation local exploit, to obtain a root shell and read /root/.
